method: Every slot rendered by the installed prepareQualificationAssessment over a one-slot plan of its own task during the plan (assessment-plan.mjs projectAssessment; the rule role packed per surface part, G-1; a slot over the bound re-partitioned); the prompt renders the task, not the plan (slot 0 here and the smoke run's 8 slots: full-plan render byte-equal); input tokens = prompt bytes / 4; output by material-selection.json plan.outputModel; the execution slots carry the item 3 stand-in

parallelism4.reason: One exclusive append lock on the durable event sink (abg/event_store.ts:1594-1597): a second assess@5 run against the same event resource is refused while one holds the lock; the F11 fold reads every judgment from that one prefix (abg/qualification_proof.ts:507-511, :677-700)

c2.basis: the measured helper wall time plus the latency model over the C2 prompt with 1,000 output tokens

preparation.basis: the mean of the four measured full-scale assess@5 start admissions (dry-4 rows 0-2 and this harness's slot 0) times the in-plan slots; the live mode pays the same transport preparation before each provider spawn

observedPromptBytesPerInputToken.basis: archived prompt bytes over all input tokens of each two-turn call (C-call prompts: JSON with digests)

model.basis: least squares of the D3 two-turn provider calls' wall duration on prompt bytes and output tokens (time-projection.mjs fitLatency); applied to a slot it is an extrapolation by time.extrapolation.ratio

tokenSensitivity.note: The activation prices input at 4 bytes per token; the D3 C-call prompts carried fewer bytes per input token
